items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: when I had this little band at the Nighthawks... I took him out of a band out of Alexander, Louisiana, who was Joseph Elric.

ctx.x: Daddy played bass. Mm-hmm. And who was Joe the drummer? Joe Elric Joseph. Elric Joseph was his right name. That's right.

He was from, he was born in Louisiana, but most of his folks lived down in Galveston, Texas. Because when I sent for the band, for my little group down here to come to Indianapolis, Indiana, it was Elric Joseph that I had sent for. Mm-hmm. See, because I figured I couldn't get Freddie. Freddie was already in Detroit. I didn't know about Freddie. Freddie was living in Chicago, playing up there with Ruben Hughes and a bunch.
